phases.title: Scaffold project and entry point
phases.description: Create a minimal runnable app shell (folder layout, build or static server if needed, and a single entry so the game can load in the browser or terminal as chosen).

tasks.desc: Add project skeleton: package manifest or simple static HTML/JS/CSS layout and document how to run it locally.
Implement empty board placeholder and a title/header so you can verify the app loads.

phases.title: Core game rules and state
phases.description: Model the 3x3 board, alternating X/O turns, legal moves, and win or draw detection with no UI coupling beyond what is needed for a thin adapter.

tasks.desc: Represent board cells, apply moves, reject illegal moves, and expose read-only game state.
Detect row/column/diagonal wins and full-board draws; emit a clear terminal game-over outcome.
Wire turn order, reset/new-game action, and keep history optional but consistent with state.

phases.title: Interactive play surface
phases.description: Let a human click or type moves against the core engine: render marks, disable finished games, and show whose turn it is.

tasks.desc: Draw the grid and current marks from engine state; reflect illegal moves with user-visible feedback.
Hook clicks or keyboard to engine moves; highlight last move or winner line if feasible.
Add reset/new match control and short instructions (keys or click targets).

phases.title: Polish and sanity checks
phases.description: Tighten UX edge cases, basic smoke testing, and README notes for running and playing.

tasks.desc: Verify rapid clicks, double submission, and post-game input do not corrupt state.
Update README with run command, controls, and known limitations.
